requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that retrieval boundaries are enforced before content reaches the LLM

requests.title: Raw data to business decision pipeline
requests.show: A horizontal workflow showing raw transactions → cleaning → exploration → metrics/models → visualizations → interpretation → business decision
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that analysis involves multiple linked stages rather than only charts or code

requests.title: Data-team role map
requests.show: A collaborative diagram showing Data Engineer → reliable data → Data Analyst/Data Scientist → models/insights → ML Engineer production systems, with NLP Engineer shown as a language-specialized engineering branch
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the roles overlap and cooperate

requests.title: Anaconda Navigator concept view
requests.show: A simplified launcher-style diagram showing Anaconda Navigator opening JupyterLab, Jupyter Notebook, Spyder, VS Code, and package/environment management
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that Anaconda is a distribution/environment ecosystem, not a programming language

requests.title: IPython help workflow
requests.show: A small visual showing typing a partial NumPy function → tab completion → selecting np.arange → using help(np.arange) or np.arange?
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that interactive documentation is part of normal programming practice

requests.title: Notebook anatomy
requests.show: A notebook screen containing a Markdown heading, Python code cell, output table, chart, and interpretation text with labels
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how narrative and computation are interleaved

requests.title: Analytics tooling scale
requests.show: A left-to-right progression showing local Python/Pandas → Jupyter exploration → IDE application development → Databricks/PySpark distributed workloads
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that different tools become useful as project scale and operational complexity grow

requests.title: NumPy shape intuition
requests.show: Show a 1D array with shape (6,), a 2D 2×3 matrix with shape (2,3), and a simple 3D block labeled (2,2,3)
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that shape describes the size of each axis

requests.title: 2D NumPy indexing grid
requests.show: A 2×2 matrix containing 5,6,7,8 with labels [0,0], [0,1], [1,0], [1,1] attached to each cell
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect row/column coordinates to actual values

requests.title: Axis 0 versus axis 1
requests.show: A 3×3 matrix with arrows showing axis=0 operating row-wise/vertically and axis=1 operating column-wise/horizontally, plus small stack/split examples
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should develop an intuitive mental model of NumPy axes

requests.title: NumPy assignment view copy memory model
requests.show: Three small diagrams: assignment with two names pointing to one object, view with two objects sharing one data buffer, copy with separate buffers
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice why changing a view can affect the original but changing a copy does not

requests.title: NumPy slicing number line
requests.show: A number line for values 0–9 showing positive indices above, negative indices below, and highlighted slices for [3:6], [-3:], and [2:7:2]
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice stop-exclusion and how negative indices count from the right

requests.title: Broadcasting scalar across matrix
requests.show: A 2×2 matrix plus scalar 3, with arrows from the scalar to each cell and the resulting matrix
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that NumPy applies the scalar across all compatible elements

requests.title: Split-apply-combine
requests.show: A table split into three color-coded continent groups, each group showing a mean calculation, then recombined into a compact summary table
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand groupby as a three-stage transformation rather than a mysterious method call

requests.title: Four DataFrame join types
requests.show: A compact Venn-style or table-matching diagram showing inner, outer, left, and right joins using the same two small employee tables
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice which unmatched rows are preserved in each join

requests.title: Pivot table transformation
requests.show: Show raw rows Weather/Food/Number on the left and a summarized matrix Weather × Food on the right with arrows labeled index, columns, values, aggfunc
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how raw records become a cross-tab summary

requests.title: Datetime feature engineering
requests.show: Show one timestamp such as 2024-10-03 10:30 splitting into year=2024, month=10, day=3, hour=10, minute=30, weekday, day-of-year, quarter, day name, month name
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see datetime as a rich source of derived features

requests.title: Attribute-type decision tree
requests.show: A branching diagram: categorical → nominal/ordinal; numeric → interval/ratio; numeric also branching to discrete/continuous
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that the statistical method starts with understanding the kind of variable

requests.title: Mean median mode with an outlier
requests.show: Show a small number line with clustered values and one extreme outlier; mark mean shifting toward the outlier, median staying central, and mode at the repeated value
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why different center measures answer different questions

requests.title: Positive zero negative skew
requests.show: Three distribution curves showing left-skewed, symmetric, and right-skewed shapes, with the long tail clearly highlighted
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should identify skew direction by the direction of the tail

requests.title: Kurtosis shapes
requests.show: Three overlapping curves labeled platykurtic, mesokurtic, leptokurtic with visibly different tail/peak shapes
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should focus on relative tail weight rather than memorizing only the curve height

requests.title: Correlation intuition scatterplots
requests.show: Five mini scatterplots labeled strong positive, weak positive, near zero, weak negative, strong negative
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect correlation sign and magnitude with visual patterns

requests.title: Central Limit Theorem
requests.show: Show a non-normal population on the left and four sampling distributions of the mean for increasing n values becoming narrower and more bell-shaped

requests.title: Bayes update diagram

requests.title: Scalar vector matrix tensor hierarchy

requests.title: Matrix multiplication row by column

requests.title: Polynomial curve fitting

requests.title: Matrix rank and redundant rows

requests.title: Eigenvector transformation intuition
requests.show: Show a transformation applied to several vectors where one special vector stays on the same line but changes length; label it eigenvector v and scaling λ

requests.title: SVD decomposition
requests.show: Show matrix A splitting into U × Sigma × V-transpose, with Sigma highlighted as diagonal singular strengths

requests.title: PMF PDF CDF comparison

requests.title: Bernoulli distribution

requests.title: Normal distribution anatomy
requests.show: Bell curve centered at mean μ, showing symmetry and standard-deviation distances on both sides

requests.title: Masked image array comparison

requests.title: Scatter plot interpretation

requests.title: Chart-selection quartet

requests.title: Matplotlib subplot anatomy

requests.title: Seaborn lmplot with hue

requests.title: Histogram KDE box violin comparison

requests.title: Pairplot anatomy

requests.title: Gantt-style timeline

requests.title: Plotly interaction controls

requests.title: Dash callback flow

requests.title: JPEG quality comparison with zoomed crop
requests.show: Show the same photograph saved at high, medium, low, and extremely low JPEG quality, with a magnified crop from each version
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that dimensions can stay identical while fine detail, blocking, ringing, and file size change

requests.title: LUT color grading workflow
requests.show: Show one original photograph, a simple conceptual RGB color cube/LUT mapping, and two different graded outputs from different LUTs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that a LUT changes color mapping rather than moving image geometry

requests.title: Rotation canvas and cropping
requests.show: Show a rectangular image inside its original canvas, the same rectangle rotated so corners leave the canvas, and an enlarged output canvas containing the full rotation
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that rotation clipping is a canvas-size problem, not a rotation failure

requests.title: Four-point homography
requests.show: Show a photographed book/document as a quadrilateral with four labeled source corners, the four ordered destination rectangle corners, and the perspective-corrected output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that each source point must correspond to the correct destination point

requests.title: Calibrated fisheye correction pipeline
requests.show: Show a distorted checkerboard, a simplified camera intrinsic/distortion-parameter block, remapping arrows, and the corrected checkerboard with straighter lines
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect calibration parameters to coordinate remapping rather than thinking undistortion is just a cosmetic filter

requests.title: Wand distortion comparison
requests.show: Show one source image beside barrel, polar, arc, Shepard/w local warp, and inverse-barrel corrected examples
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare global radial distortion, coordinate-system remapping, arc bending, local control-point warping, and approximate inversion

requests.title: Grayscale image and contour interpretation
requests.show: Show a grayscale image as an intensity surface concept, the original image, contour lines at several intensity levels, and filled contours
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that contours connect equal-intensity locations rather than automatically representing object boundaries

requests.title: Sampling versus quantization
requests.show: Show a smooth continuous grayscale surface on the left, a spatial sampling grid in the middle, and the same samples restricted to a small number of intensity levels on the right
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should clearly distinguish discretizing position from discretizing pixel value

requests.title: Nearest-neighbor upsampling
requests.show: Show a tiny 4×4 pixel grid enlarged several times with visible square blocks and duplicated values
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that nearest-neighbor copies existing samples rather than estimating smooth transitions

requests.title: Nyquist and image aliasing
requests.show: Show a fine stripe pattern at high resolution, a badly downsampled version with a Moiré pattern, and a properly low-pass-filtered/anti-aliased downsample
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see high-frequency detail turning into false lower-frequency structure when undersampled

requests.title: Intensity quantization levels
requests.show: Show one smooth grayscale photograph or gradient at high precision, 16 levels, 8 levels, and 4 levels
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice banding/contouring increasing as the number of allowed intensities decreases

requests.title: Spatial image, magnitude, and phase
requests.show: Show one grayscale image beside its centered log-magnitude spectrum and phase spectrum; label center as low frequency and outer regions as higher frequency
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect the image to two complementary Fourier representations

requests.title: Magnitude versus phase reconstruction
requests.show: Show two source images, reconstruction using magnitude from A + phase from B, and reconstruction using phase from A + unrelated magnitude; include a random-phase example
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that phase strongly controls recognizable structure

requests.title: DCT basis and energy concentration
requests.show: Show a small grid of low-order 2D DCT basis patterns plus a DCT spectrum whose strong coefficients cluster near the low-frequency origin
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that the image can be represented as weights on cosine patterns and that much energy often concentrates in a small region

requests.title: Gibbs ringing and smoothing
requests.show: Show a sharp binary circle, its Fourier spectrum with oscillatory structure, a Gaussian-smoothed circle, and its smoother spectrum/reconstruction
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect sharp discontinuities to high-frequency content and ringing behavior

requests.title: Fourier transform property summary
requests.show: A four-panel figure showing spatial rotation with rotated spectrum, spatial stretching with contracted spectrum, spatial translation with unchanged magnitude but changed phase, and linear addition in spatial/frequency domains
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should visually connect common spatial operations with their Fourier consequences

requests.title: Common kernels and outputs
requests.show: Show one source image with box blur, Laplacian edge, sharpen, and emboss kernels beside their corresponding outputs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that changing only kernel weights changes the visual operation

requests.title: Full same valid convolution modes
requests.show: Use a simple 5×5 input grid and 3×3 kernel to show visually which output positions are retained for valid, same, and full modes and how their output dimensions differ
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that mode controls output extent, not the kernel itself

requests.title: Template matching correlation map
requests.show: Show a larger face/object image, a cropped template, the resulting correlation heatmap, and the detected best-match location marked on the source
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that template matching searches for the maximum similarity response

requests.title: Convolution theorem pipeline
requests.show: Show spatial image and kernel entering separate FFT blocks, element-wise multiplication of their spectra, then IFFT to produce the filtered image; alongside show the equivalent sliding spatial convolution
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that spatial convolution and frequency multiplication are two representations of the same linear filtering operation

requests.title: Gaussian kernel spatial and frequency views
requests.show: Show a 2D Gaussian kernel as an image/3D surface beside its centered Fourier magnitude response, with low-frequency center bright and high-frequency outer regions dark
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why Gaussian convolution behaves as low-pass filtering

requests.title: 2D versus 3D convolution
requests.show: Show a 2D kernel sliding across H×W while spanning input channels, then a 3D kernel sliding across D×H×W for a volume/video; label channel versus depth axes carefully
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should not confuse RGB channels with the third sliding spatial dimension of a true 3D convolution

requests.title: Upsampling versus transposed convolution
requests.show: Show one low-resolution feature map passing through fixed interpolation + Conv2d versus ConvTranspose2d, with a small checkerboard artifact example on the transposed-convolution side
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish fixed geometric enlargement from learned upsampling and recognize uneven-overlap artifacts

requests.title: Frequency filtering pipeline
requests.show: Show one grayscale image, its centered Fourier magnitude spectrum, a circular filter mask, the masked spectrum, and the reconstructed output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that frequency filtering is coefficient selection/attenuation followed by inverse transformation

requests.title: LPF HPF BPF and BSF masks
requests.show: Show four centered radial frequency masks: low-pass bright center, high-pass dark center, band-pass bright ring, and band-stop dark ring/notches
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should visually associate each filter name with which frequency region is preserved

requests.title: Ideal Butterworth Gaussian responses
requests.show: Show 1D radial response curves and corresponding 2D circular low-pass masks for Ideal, Butterworth at two orders, and Gaussian
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how transition smoothness differs and why abrupt filters can ring

requests.title: LPF cutoff comparison
requests.show: Show the same image filtered with small, medium, and large low-pass cutoffs, plus their circular masks
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that increasing cutoff preserves progressively more image detail

requests.title: LPF versus HPF
requests.show: Show one source image, its low-pass result, high-pass result, and their corresponding centered masks
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see coarse structure in LPF and edge/detail structure in HPF

requests.title: Difference of Gaussians band-pass intuition
requests.show: Show two Gaussian low-pass response curves with different widths, their subtraction producing a band-shaped response, and an image output emphasizing mid-scale structure
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why subtracting two smoothing scales isolates a frequency band

requests.title: Periodic noise and notch filtering
requests.show: Show a clean image, same image with sinusoidal stripes, centered spectrum with symmetric bright interference peaks marked, notch mask over those peaks, and restored image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why periodic noise is especially suitable for frequency-domain removal

requests.title: Fourier Feature Network architecture
requests.show: Show pixel coordinate (x,y), multiplication by frequency matrix B, parallel sin/cos encoding, concatenated Fourier features, MLP, and predicted RGB pixel
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that Fourier features enrich the coordinate input before the network

requests.title: Fourier mapping reconstruction comparison
requests.show: Show ground-truth image beside reconstructions from raw coordinates, basic Fourier mapping, low-scale Gaussian mapping, medium-scale mapping, and high-scale mapping, plus small PSNR labels
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare how mapping frequency affects fine-detail reconstruction

requests.title: Image enhancement strategy map
requests.show: A diagram grouping enhancement methods by information used: single pixel, global histogram, local neighborhood, non-local patches, multi-scale wavelets, and learned models
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that enhancement methods differ mainly in what context they use to decide a new pixel value

requests.title: Gamma transform curves and images
requests.show: Show gamma curves for gamma < 1, gamma = 1, gamma > 1 plus the same image transformed with each case
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should remember that gamma below one brightens darker intensities while gamma above one darkens them in the source convention

requests.title: Threshold vs random dithering vs Floyd-Steinberg
requests.show: Show the same grayscale photograph converted by hard thresholding, random dithering, and Floyd–Steinberg dithering
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare false contours, noise-like halftone structure, and structured error diffusion

requests.title: Histogram processing comparison
requests.show: Show original low-contrast image and histogram beside contrast stretching, global histogram equalization, and adaptive histogram equalization with their histograms/CDFs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see the difference between global range expansion and local contrast redistribution

requests.title: Mamdani fuzzy enhancement
requests.show: Show input intensity axis with dark/medium/bright membership curves, three IF-THEN rules, aggregated output membership functions, and one defuzzified output intensity
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the four-step fuzzy inference pipeline

requests.title: White-balance methods
requests.show: Show one color-cast input beside Gray World, White Patch, percentile White Patch, and Shades of Gray results
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare how different illuminant assumptions change RGB channel scaling

requests.title: Box versus Gaussian smoothing
requests.show: Show a noisy image, box-filter outputs with two kernel sizes, and Gaussian outputs with two sigma/radius values
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see stronger smoothing with larger neighborhoods and the different weighting behavior of box versus Gaussian filters

requests.title: Order-statistic filters
requests.show: Show a salt-and-pepper corrupted image beside median, mode, minimum, maximum, and 25/50/75 percentile outputs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that these filters choose ranked neighborhood values rather than averages

requests.title: Bilateral versus non-local means
requests.show: Show a target pixel/patch, bilateral local neighborhood weighted by distance+intensity, and NLM searching for similar patches across a larger region
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish local pixel similarity from non-local patch similarity

requests.title: Streamlit enhancement app architecture
requests.show: Show user/upload controls feeding app.py, then a separate enhancement-engine module, then original/enhanced preview panels
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see the benefit of keeping UI and image-processing logic modular

requests.title: BM3D pipeline
requests.show: Show noisy image, extraction of one reference patch, matching similar patches across the image, stacking into a 3D group, collaborative transform-domain filtering, and aggregation back into a denoised image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why the method is called block-matching and 3D filtering

requests.title: 2D wavelet decomposition
requests.show: Show an input image splitting into the four standard wavelet sub-bands LL, LH, HL, HH with labels for approximation and directional details
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see wavelet decomposition as a multi-scale separation of coarse structure and details

requests.title: Zero-DCE iterative enhancement
requests.show: Show low-light input, DCE-Net predicting per-pixel alpha maps, several iterative curve-adjustment stages, and final enhanced image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that the network predicts adaptive enhancement curves rather than directly outputting an unrelated image

requests.title: Dark Channel Prior dehazing
requests.show: Show hazy input, dark-channel image, estimated atmospheric-light marker/vector, transmission map, and reconstructed dehazed result
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the sequence from statistical prior to transmission estimation to scene recovery

requests.title: Bicubic versus EDSR super-resolution
requests.show: Show the same low-resolution crop, bicubic ×4 enlargement, and EDSR ×4 output with a magnified edge/texture region
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare fixed interpolation with learned detail reconstruction

requests.title: Image profile and first derivative
requests.show: Show a 1D row through alternating dark/bright image regions, the corresponding intensity profile, and derivative spikes at transitions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why edges appear as peaks in first-order derivatives

requests.title: Laplacian variance blur comparison
requests.show: Show the same image as original, box-blurred, and Gaussian-blurred, with the Laplacian response and variance score beneath each
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why blur reduces derivative energy

requests.title: Unsharp masking pipeline
requests.show: Show original image, blurred image, extracted high-frequency detail layer (original minus blur), and sharpened result
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see sharpening as adding back amplified detail

requests.title: Classical edge detector comparison
requests.show: Show one grayscale scene beside Roberts, Prewitt, Sobel, Scharr, and Laplacian edge responses
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare edge thickness, directional sensitivity, and noise response rather than memorizing kernel names

requests.title: Kirsch compass edge detector
requests.show: Show the eight compass directions around a central pixel, representative Kirsch masks, and a final map formed by taking the maximum directional response
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand multi-orientation edge detection

requests.title: Canny four-stage pipeline
requests.show: Show noisy/grayscale input, Gaussian-smoothed image, gradient magnitude/orientation, non-maximum-suppressed thin edges, and final hysteresis-linked edge map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that Canny is a pipeline, not just one convolution kernel

requests.title: LoG DoG and zero crossings
requests.show: Show Gaussian smoothing, LoG kernel/response, DoG approximation, and binary zero-crossing edge contours
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect smoothing, second derivative, and sign changes

requests.title: Multiscale blob detection
requests.show: Show the same image with LoG, DoG, and DoH detected blobs drawn as circles of different radii
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that detector scale becomes an estimate of feature size

requests.title: Hessian ridge detection
requests.show: Show a retinal/vessel-like image, local Hessian ellipse/eigen-directions at one vessel point, and Meijering/Sato/Frangi/Hessian outputs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect directional curvature with vessel-like structure

requests.title: Isotropic versus anisotropic diffusion
requests.show: Show a noisy edge profile and two smoothing outcomes: isotropic blur crossing the edge, anisotropic diffusion smoothing inside regions while retaining the boundary
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand gradient-controlled diffusion

requests.title: HED versus PiDiNet
requests.show: Show one natural image beside PiDiNet and HED edge maps, labeling PiDiNet as sparse/crisp and HED as richer/hierarchical
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the accuracy/context versus efficiency trade-off described in the source

requests.title: Gaussian and Laplacian pyramids
requests.show: Show the same image as a Gaussian pyramid of progressively smaller blurred levels and a Laplacian pyramid of corresponding detail/band-pass layers
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish coarse low-frequency representations from multiscale detail layers

requests.title: Pyramid image blending
requests.show: Show two source images, a mask, Laplacian levels from both images, Gaussian mask levels, level-wise blending, and final seamless composite
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why blending across scales is smoother than direct binary masking

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Inverse filtering instability
requests.show: Show a blur transfer function with near-zero high-frequency values, a noisy spectrum divided by the transfer function, and amplified high-frequency noise in the restored image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why small H values cause unstable inversion

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Inverse vs Wiener deconvolution
requests.show: Show original, blurred+noisy, inverse-filter restoration with amplified noise, and Wiener restoration balancing sharpness and noise
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand Wiener filtering as regularized statistical inversion

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Data fidelity and regularization balance
requests.show: Show a slider-like diagram from small lambda with noisy/sharp restoration to large lambda with oversmoothed restoration, with a balanced solution in the middle
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see regularization as controlled bias added to stabilize inversion

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Högbom CLEAN workflow
requests.show: Show dirty astronomical image, PSF, strongest residual peak selection, subtraction of shifted PSF, accumulated sparse clean components, restoring beam, and final restored image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand CLEAN as greedy PSF matching under a sparsity prior

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Dictionary-learning denoising
requests.show: Show noisy image, overlapping 8×8 patches, learned dictionary atoms, sparse coefficient vector with few nonzeros, reconstructed patches, and overlap-averaged restored image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand sparse restoration as projection onto learned local structure

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Classical prior vs learned prior
requests.show: Show Tikhonov as explicit formula/prior on one side and NAFNet learning degraded-to-clean mapping from pairs on the other
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the shift from hand-designed priors to data-learned priors

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: InstructIR multimodal restoration
requests.show: Show degraded image plus natural-language instruction entering image-restoration and language branches, fused representation, and restored output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand restoration conditioned jointly on image evidence and user intent

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Diffusion inpainting pipeline
requests.show: Show damaged image, binary mask, encoded latent with masked region noised, text-conditioned denoising UNet, and final completed image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that only the masked region should be synthesized while context remains consistent

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: LaMa large-mask inpainting
requests.show: Show original image with a large missing region, binary mask, local-context challenge, global/Fourier receptive-field concept, and completed result
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why long-range context matters for large holes

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: DiffEdit workflow
requests.show: Show original image, source/target prompts, automatically inferred mask, DDIM inversion to latent space, target-conditioned denoising, and edited output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand mask inference and latent inversion as separate steps

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Inpainting vs editing vs retouching
requests.show: Show three branches from one source image: masked hole filling, object replacement via prompt, and low-strength whole-image retouch with mostly preserved structure
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish the task objective, not just the model family

requests.lesson_title: Image Restoration: Inverse Problems in Imaging
requests.title: Outpainting canvas expansion
requests.show: Show original image centered in a larger blank canvas, mask over added borders, diffusion generation in the new area, and final extended scene
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see outpainting as inpainting over newly created canvas regions

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Segmentation evolution map
requests.show: Show one image flowing through threshold-based regions, watershed regions, superpixels/graphs, CNN semantic map, instance masks, and panoptic output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see segmentation evolving from hand-crafted local rules to learned global/object-centric reasoning

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Multi-Otsu histogram segmentation
requests.show: Show grayscale image, multimodal histogram with two threshold lines, and three-color region label map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect histogram peaks and valleys with threshold-based class separation

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Marker-controlled watershed
requests.show: Show grayscale image, gradient topography, marker seeds, flooding concept, and final labeled watershed regions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see markers controlling where basins begin and strong gradients stopping region growth

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Coin counting pipeline
requests.show: Show original coins, threshold mask, cleaned morphology mask, distance transform, local-max markers, watershed-separated coins, and final counted/centroid-labeled objects
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand segmentation as a multi-stage pipeline rather than a single function

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: SLIC MaskSLIC and RAG
requests.show: Show original image, SLIC superpixels, object mask, MaskSLIC constrained superpixels, adjacency graph over regions, and merged output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish over-segmentation from later region merging

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Chan-Vese energy evolution
requests.show: Show original weak-edge image, initial contour/level set, intermediate evolving contour, final binary region, and decreasing energy curve
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see segmentation emerging from region statistics rather than explicit edge detection

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: GrabCut graph model
requests.show: Show image with bounding box/scribbles, foreground and background GMM appearance models, pixel graph connected to source/sink, min-cut boundary, and extracted object
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the combination of user hints, appearance likelihood, and neighborhood smoothness

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Random-Forest pixel segmentation
requests.show: Show image, sparse hand-labeled training regions, multiscale feature stack, Random Forest, and dense predicted segmentation map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see the bridge from handcrafted features to supervised pixel classification

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: FCN semantic segmentation
requests.show: Show encoder feature hierarchy, 1×1 class-score maps, skip fusion from shallow/deep layers, upsampling, and final pixel-wise semantic map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why dense prediction differs from image classification

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: DeepLab ASPP
requests.show: Show feature map entering parallel atrous convolution branches with different dilation rates plus pooled/global context, then feature fusion and semantic prediction
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see ASPP as multiscale context without aggressive spatial downsampling

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Mask R-CNN architecture
requests.show: Show image→backbone/FPN→RPN proposals→ROIAlign→parallel classification, box regression, and mask branches→separate instance masks
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the two-stage instance-segmentation pipeline

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Q K V self-attention for image patches
requests.show: Show image split into patches/tokens, one token producing Query, all tokens providing Keys/Values, attention weights to distant patches, and aggregated context
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand global interaction between image regions

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: SETR versus DPT
requests.show: Show SETR using one final ViT token grid and simple upsampling versus DPT taking features from several transformer depths and fusing them into a dense output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why multi-level fusion improves localization

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: DETR object queries
requests.show: Show transformer image features plus several learned object-query tokens attending globally and producing class/mask predictions that combine into a panoptic segmentation map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand object-centric query prediction versus per-pixel classification

requests.lesson_title: Image Segmentation: From Classical Methods to Deep Learning
requests.title: Pixel classification vs mask classification
requests.show: Show left: independent per-pixel semantic labels; right: transformer queries predicting mask–class pairs that combine into semantic, instance, or panoptic outputs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the Mask2Former paradigm shift

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Fixed-label versus promptable segmentation
requests.show: Show left: image entering a fixed-class semantic model producing a predefined class map; right: the same image plus point/box/text prompts entering a prompt-conditioned model producing different masks
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that the prompt changes the requested segmentation without retraining

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: SAM architecture and prompt types
requests.show: Show image encoder producing reusable embedding, prompt encoder receiving a point and box, mask decoder, and several candidate masks with quality scores
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why the same image representation can answer different segmentation prompts

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Language-aligned segmentation
requests.show: Show image regions encoded into visual embeddings, text prompts such as "car", "person", "water" encoded into text embeddings, cosine-similarity matching, and resulting masks
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how text replaces a fixed output-class list

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: CLIPSeg interactive pipeline
requests.show: Show image + text prompt entering a shared vision-language encoder/decoder, a soft probability heatmap, thresholded binary mask, and colored overlay
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish logits/probabilities from the final thresholded mask

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Monocular depth with DPT
requests.show: Show RGB scene, transformer/DPT block, dense depth prediction, and normalized heatmap with nearby and distant regions labeled
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand depth as a dense geometric prediction derived from monocular visual cues

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Depth to point-cloud projection
requests.show: Show image pixel (x,y), camera intrinsic model, depth z, back-projection ray, resulting XYZ point, and a colored point cloud reconstructed from all pixels
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect the depth map with actual 3D geometry

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Real-time background blur
requests.show: Show original portrait, semantic foreground mask, strongly blurred full image, and final composite with sharp foreground + blurred background
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see segmentation as an enabling component inside an application

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: U-Net architecture
requests.show: Show contracting encoder, bottleneck, expanding decoder, skip connections at matching scales, and final 1×1 pixel-classification layer
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how U-Net combines semantic context and boundary detail

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Segmentation training pipeline
requests.show: Show image/mask dataset → augmentation → batching → encoder-decoder network → logits → segmentation loss → backpropagation → validation metrics → saved model
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see segmentation training as an end-to-end data/model/evaluation system

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Brain tumor MRI segmentation
requests.show: Show MRI slice, ground-truth tumor mask, predicted probability heatmap, thresholded binary prediction, and colored overlay
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why overlap-based loss/metrics matter for small medical regions

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Swin-UNETR volumetric segmentation
requests.show: Show 3D CT volume entering shifted-window Swin encoder stages, U-Net decoder with skips, and 3D multi-organ label volume
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how transformer context and U-Net localization are combined in 3D

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: CT mask to 3D mesh
requests.show: Show axial CT slices and voxel segmentation feeding marching cubes, resulting liver/organ mesh, then combined 3D volume + colored organ meshes
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that segmentation can become patient-specific 3D geometry

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Remote sensing segmentation challenges
requests.show: Show large satellite image with tiled grid, class-frequency bar chart with rare roads/water, and same land-cover class under several sensor/season appearances
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why patching, class weighting, augmentation, and attention are useful

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Satellite tiled inference
requests.show: Show very large satellite image split into patches, MAnet processing each patch, predicted tiles, stitching/reconstruction, and final full-resolution land-cover map
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how models trained on patches can segment images too large for one GPU pass

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: IoU versus Dice geometry
requests.show: Show ground-truth and predicted binary masks with intersection/union regions highlighted, plus formulas for IoU and Dice
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand both metrics from set overlap rather than memorizing equations only

requests.lesson_title: More Deep Learning Methods for Image Segmentation
requests.title: Segmentation metric selection
requests.show: Show four panels: IoU/Dice overlap for semantic masks, class-imbalance example exposing accuracy weakness, precision-recall curve and AP area, and instance masks evaluated across IoU thresholds for mAP
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should know which metric matches which segmentation problem

requests.title: Pixel space to semantic embedding space
requests.show: Show several animal images passing through a CNN into high-dimensional vectors, then a 2D conceptual embedding where dogs cluster together, cats cluster together, and unrelated animals are farther apart
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that representation geometry becomes semantically meaningful

requests.title: PCA versus t-SNE on MNIST
requests.show: Show the same digit samples projected with PCA and t-SNE, using class colors
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see PCA preserving linear variance while t-SNE emphasizes local neighborhood separation

requests.title: CNN feature hierarchy
requests.show: Show one image with feature visualizations from an early, middle, and deep ResNet layer: edges → textures → object parts/semantic region
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how internal representations become increasingly abstract

requests.title: Transfer learning workflow
requests.show: Show pretrained ImageNet CNN, removal of original classifier, frozen backbone, new binary cat-vs-dog head, then optional fine-tuning of deepest layers
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish feature extraction from fine-tuning

requests.title: Channel and spatial attention
requests.show: Show CNN feature tensor, channel-attention weights amplifying selected channels, then spatial mask highlighting important image regions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should remember channel attention = what, spatial attention = where

requests.title: ViT classification and attention rollout
requests.show: Show image split into patches, tokens entering transformer blocks, CLS/class output, and a patch-level attention heatmap over the source image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand both patch tokenization and global self-attention

requests.title: CLIP zero-shot vs DINOv2 few-shot
requests.show: Show CLIP comparing one image embedding to several text embeddings; beside it show DINOv2 averaging two support embeddings per class into prototypes and classifying a query by cosine similarity
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish language-based zero-shot from visual-prototype few-shot learning

requests.title: Face embedding recognition
requests.show: Show several gallery identities mapped to compact clusters/prototypes in embedding space, a query face mapped nearby, cosine similarity scores, and an Unknown threshold
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand recognition as nearest-prototype metric matching rather than fixed closed-set classification

requests.title: Deterministic vs Bayesian vs MC Dropout
requests.show: Show deterministic model producing one prediction; Bayesian model sampling several weight sets; MC Dropout sampling several dropout masks; both stochastic methods producing mean probability + uncertainty
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand uncertainty as disagreement across plausible model realizations

requests.title: FixMatch-style learning loop
requests.show: Show small labeled set and large unlabeled set, weak augmentation creating high-confidence pseudo-labels, strong augmentation, consistency loss, and combined model update
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how the model turns reliable guesses into temporary supervision

requests.title: Masked Autoencoder pipeline
requests.show: Show image split into patches, ~75% patches hidden, visible patches entering ViT encoder, mask tokens/decoder reconstructing the missing regions, and reconstructed image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how unlabeled images supervise themselves

requests.title: Federated averaging
requests.show: Show central server distributing one model to several clients with different private image distributions, local training, model updates returning, weighted aggregation, and next global round
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that models move while raw data stays local

requests.title: FGSM adversarial perturbation
requests.show: Show clean image, loss gradient sign pattern, tiny scaled perturbation, adversarial image that looks visually similar, and changed classifier prediction
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that the perturbation follows the direction that increases model loss

requests.title: Semantic image retrieval pipeline
requests.show: Show image database → EfficientNet embeddings → PCA/vector index; query image → embedding → cosine similarity → ranked visually/semantically similar results
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see retrieval as nearest-neighbor search in feature space

requests.title: Classification vs detection
requests.show: Show same street image: classification returning one global label; detection returning several boxes with class names/confidences
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that detection combines recognition and spatial localization

requests.title: RetinaNet and focal loss
requests.show: Show image pyramid/FPN levels feeding one-stage classification and box heads, plus a small chart where focal loss downweights easy high-confidence background examples
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should connect FPN with scale and focal loss with foreground-background imbalance

requests.title: RetinaNet vs Mask R-CNN output
requests.show: Show one scene with RetinaNet bounding boxes and beside it Mask R-CNN with boxes plus individual colored pixel masks and contours
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand what instance masks add beyond rectangular localization

requests.title: OCR model evolution
requests.show: Show document/scene image passing through Tesseract baseline, PaddleOCR detection+angle+recognition pipeline, EasyOCR detection/recognition, and TrOCR vision-encoder→text-decoder pipeline
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish preprocessing-heavy OCR from learned detection/recognition and end-to-end vision-to-text modeling

requests.title: Face landmarks and AR overlay
requests.show: Show dense face mesh, selected eye/nose/mouth anchor points, inter-eye distance used for scaling, and final sunglasses/moustache overlay
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see landmarks as geometric anchors for stable augmentation

requests.title: Hand landmark graph
requests.show: Show 21 labeled hand keypoints connected into finger chains, with fingertips emphasized and left/right handedness output
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how a dense pose becomes a compact graph representation

requests.title: FOMM motion transfer
requests.show: Show static source portrait, driving-video frame with learned motion keypoints, dense deformation field, and generated source-identity frame following the driving pose
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand appearance comes from the source while motion comes from the driver

requests.title: YOLOv8 car-damage assessment
requests.show: Show damaged car, predicted damage instance masks, mask-area pixel count, and rule-based severity label
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the separation between learned damage localization and hand-designed downstream severity logic

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Evolution of generative vision
requests.show: Show a timeline/flow from cGAN/CVAE → Pix2Pix/CycleGAN → StyleGAN/GFPGAN → DDPM/LDM → Stable Diffusion/SDXL → ControlNet/IP-Adapter → multimodal image APIs
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see increasingly flexible conditioning and control

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Conditional GAN architecture
requests.show: Show latent z and class label y entering the generator; real/generated images plus the same label entering a projection discriminator with realism + class-compatibility scoring
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that conditioning affects both generation and discrimination

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: CVAE architecture
requests.show: Show image + class label entering encoder → mu/logvar → reparameterization z → decoder + same class label → reconstruction, with reconstruction loss and KL regularization arrows
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why the latent space becomes smooth and sampleable

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Conditional latent traversal
requests.show: Show a row transitioning between two Fashion-MNIST classes and a second row varying style within one fixed class, plus a small t-SNE cluster view
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish semantic class control from within-class latent variation

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Pix2Pix versus CycleGAN
requests.show: Show paired input-target examples for Pix2Pix with one generator/discriminator path; beside it show unpaired horse/zebra collections with two generators and cycle-consistency loops
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should remember paired correspondence versus unpaired reversible translation

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: StyleGAN latent and style mixing
requests.show: Show z→mapping→W styles→synthesis layers, plus a grid where row latent controls coarse structure and column latent controls fine appearance
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand layer-wise semantic control

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: GFPGAN restoration
requests.show: Show low-quality face → restoration encoder/network → pretrained StyleGAN facial prior → reconstructed face → paste-back into original image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how a strong learned facial prior can recreate plausible detail

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: DDPM forward and reverse processes
requests.show: Show clean image progressively corrupted to Gaussian noise across timesteps, then a U-Net+scheduler iteratively reversing the process from noise back to a synthesized image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see generation as repeated denoising

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Pixel diffusion vs latent diffusion
requests.show: Show high-resolution pixel-space diffusion on left; on right VAE encoder compresses image to small latent grid, diffusion happens there, then decoder reconstructs image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see why latent diffusion reduces compute

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Stable Diffusion architecture
requests.show: Show text prompt→text encoder, random latent→U-Net denoising loop with scheduler and cross-attention, VAE decoder→image
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand the four-module latent diffusion pipeline

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: InstructPix2Pix editing
requests.show: Show source sketch and text instruction entering an image-conditioned diffusion pipeline, then a realistic edited handbag/product output that preserves silhouette and layout
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see editing as source-conditioned generation rather than generation from scratch

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: ControlNet Canny guidance
requests.show: Show original horse, Canny edge control image, text prompt "zebra", ControlNet branch injecting structure into Stable Diffusion U-Net, and generated zebra preserving pose/composition
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand structure and semantics as separate conditioning sources

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Diffusion application grid
requests.show: Show six panels: fast text-to-image, typography poster, image-to-image refinement, restoration, style conversion with structural control, super-resolution, and inpainting
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should recognize one diffusion family solving many image-processing tasks through different conditioning

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: IP-Adapter plus ControlNet
requests.show: Show text prompt, reference portrait, OpenPose skeleton entering one diffusion pipeline and producing several portraits with similar appearance but the target pose
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand independent semantic, appearance, and geometric conditioning

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Same-prompt generation comparison
requests.show: Show one complex prompt above two rows of generated images labeled DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3, with callouts for composition, prompt adherence, and typography
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should focus on evaluation dimensions rather than API syntax

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Multimodal understand-and-edit loop
requests.show: Show input image → vision model → textual assessment/instruction plan → image editing model → edited result, with arrows indicating text and image information flow
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see reasoning/understanding and image synthesis as complementary capabilities

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Classical-plus-generative hybrid
requests.show: Show original image→Canny edge detector→binary/RGBA edge mask→generative editing prompt→glowing artistic edge result
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see traditional CV used as controllable preprocessing for generative AI

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Prompt-driven editing taxonomy
requests.show: Show one source image branching into colorization, object recolor, object removal, background replacement, style transfer, restoration, and seasonal transformation
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should distinguish local edits, masked edits, global appearance changes, and full scene transformations

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Industrial inspection with structured output
requests.show: Show manufactured parts image entering a vision-language model and producing a structured defect table/JSON with location, severity, confidence, and summary
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see multimodal models as report-generating assistants rather than only classifiers

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Multimodal visual analysis domains
requests.show: Show VQA image+question, factory inspection image+JSON, before/after satellite images+change report, and MRI+non-diagnostic educational description
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see the same image-language interface applied across very different domains

requests.lesson_title: Generative AI in Image Processing and Computer Vision
requests.title: Multimodal scientific workflow
requests.show: Show scientific image/diagram entering a vision-language model, structured reasoning in the middle, then generated educational/scientific visualization
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand image→reasoning→image as a reusable workflow pattern

requests.title: Five-stage evolution of AI agents
requests.show: A left-to-right diagram showing Stage 0 classical agents, Stage 1 foundation models, Stage 2 foundation models plus RAG, Stage 3 tool-using agents, and Stage 4 multi-agent systems
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that retrieval adds knowledge, tools add action, and multi-agent systems add specialization and collaboration

requests.title: Sense-think-act agent loop
requests.show: A circular diagram with Environment -> Perception -> Foundation Model / Reasoning -> Tool or Action -> Environment, with Goal and Instructions influencing the reasoning step
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that an agent is a loop interacting with an environment, not merely a single model response

requests.title: Complete single-turn agent execution loop
requests.show: A six-stage flow showing User -> Model with instructions/tools -> Function-call request -> Host application execution -> Tool result -> Model final response
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the execution boundary: the model requests an action, while application code performs it

requests.title: Short-term and long-term memory architecture
requests.show: A diagram showing one active conversation feeding short-term/session memory, with selected durable facts or summaries written to long-term storage and later retrieved into a future session
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that session history and cross-session memory serve different purposes

requests.title: Five multi-agent orchestration patterns
requests.show: One figure containing Router, Parallel, Sequential, Circular, and Dynamic patterns with small labeled node-and-arrow diagrams
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare how control flow differs across the five designs

requests.title: Cascaded pipeline versus live multimodal session
requests.show: Side-by-side diagram: left shows Microphone -> ASR -> Text Model -> TTS -> Speaker; right shows Audio + Visual Frames + Text entering one stateful multimodal session that streams audio/text/tool events
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice fewer developer-visible processing boundaries and that text transcription is no longer the mandatory bridge for every modality

requests.title: From raw modalities to learned representations
requests.show: A diagram with Text -> Tokens/Embeddings, Image -> Patches/Visual Representations, and Audio -> Acoustic Features/Audio Representations, all feeding a shared reasoning context
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that raw media is transformed before cross-modal reasoning occurs

requests.title: Point-and-ask multimodal fusion
requests.show: A user points at one component on a circuit board while asking "What is this part?", with arrows from the spoken phrase and indicated image region into one shared context
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that neither speech nor image alone fully resolves the word "this"

requests.title: Intent-and-slot voice assistant
requests.show: A diagram showing several example utterances flowing into one Intent block, with extracted slots such as song_title and artist_name feeding a predefined backend action
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the system behaves like a structured form-filling pipeline rather than open-ended contextual reasoning

requests.title: REST versus WebSocket communication
requests.show: Side-by-side diagram: REST shows separate Request -> Response cycles that repeatedly open logical exchanges, while WebSocket shows one persistent bidirectional connection with audio/events flowing in both directions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that live conversation benefits from a continuously open two-way channel

requests.title: Acoustic echo feedback loop
requests.show: A diagram showing AI audio leaving the speakers, being picked up by the microphone, entering VAD, and accidentally triggering interruption; beside it, show browser audio processing/AEC reducing that feedback path
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand why full-duplex voice systems must control self-captured playback

requests.title: Two-WebSocket real-time voice architecture
requests.show: Browser on the left with UI, microphone, and speaker; Python proxy in the middle; Live model service on the right; show one bidirectional WebSocket between browser and proxy and another between proxy and model
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the proxy protects credentials while relaying a continuous two-way stream

requests.title: Browser microphone processing pipeline
requests.show: Microphone -> MediaStream -> AudioContext -> AudioWorklet -> Float32-to-Int16 conversion -> fixed-size PCM chunks -> main thread -> WebSocket
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that high-frequency audio processing is separated from ordinary UI work

requests.title: Concurrent proxy forwarding
requests.show: The proxy in the center with two independent async loops: one arrow Browser -> Proxy -> Model and another arrow Model -> Proxy -> Browser, both running simultaneously
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that full-duplex communication requires independent concurrent receive/send paths

requests.title: Streaming audio playback queue
requests.show: Incoming Base64 audio chunks enter a queue, each is decoded into PCM/Float32 AudioBuffer, then Buffer 1 -> Buffer 2 -> Buffer 3 plays sequentially through the speaker
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that queueing hides network chunk boundaries and prevents audible gaps

requests.title: Hot-mic conversational state machine
requests.show: States: Session inactive -> Listening -> AI speaking -> user interruption -> Listening, plus Mic muted as a side state that preserves the session
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that session lifetime, microphone state, VAD turn detection, and playback interruption are separate pieces of state

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: Persona configuration layers
requests.show: A diagram showing System Instructions controlling tone/rules and Voice Configuration controlling speech sound, both feeding the same live assistant session
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that character is produced by multiple configuration layers rather than one prompt alone

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: Local smooth video vs sampled AI frames
requests.show: A live camera stream displayed smoothly to the user on the left, while only periodic snapshots (for example at t=0s, 1s, 2s) are sent to the AI on the right
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the user can see full-motion video while the model receives a much lower-rate visual stream

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: Multimodal proxy flow
requests.show: Browser sends two labeled streams, Audio and JPEG Frames, into one backend proxy; proxy decodes each and forwards both into one live model session
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that one session can receive multiple input types through the same application architecture

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: Live function-calling loop
requests.show: User asks weather -> live model chooses get_weather(city) -> backend tool handler calls external weather API -> API result returns to backend -> tool response returns to model -> spoken answer goes back to user
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that external execution happens in backend code, not inside the model

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: Mobile-first assistant UI layout
requests.show: A phone mockup with a large start/play button before session start, then large circular stop/mic/camera controls after connection, a prominent video preview area, and contextual switch-camera control
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice reduced clutter, large touch targets, and state-dependent controls

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: From source code to running cloud service
requests.show: Source files + requirements + Dockerfile -> container image -> registry -> Cloud Run service -> public HTTPS/WSS endpoint
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that Docker packages the app while Cloud Run runs the resulting container

requests.lesson_title: Advanced Live Interactions: Vision, Tools, and Deployment
requests.title: End-to-end advanced assistant architecture
requests.show: Mobile browser with microphone/camera on left -> secure frontend connection -> cloud backend proxy in center -> live multimodal model plus external weather/tool APIs on right; show tool-call loop and streamed response returning to phone
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how persona, vision, tools, UI, and deployment fit into one coherent system

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Agent framework capability map
requests.show: A central Agent Framework box connected to Orchestration, Memory, Tools, Multi-Agent Communication, Human-in-the-Loop, and Streaming/Observability
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the framework surrounds the model with operational capabilities rather than replacing the model

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Perceive-reason-act runtime loop
requests.show: A graph showing Reasoning node -> conditional edge -> Tool node -> back to Reasoning, with an END path when no more actions are required
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how a framework turns a manual while-loop into explicit orchestration

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Sequential versus parallel agent execution
requests.show: Left side shows Weather then News sequentially; right side shows Weather and News running simultaneously before a Gather step
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the latency advantage when tasks are independent

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Long-term memory RAG pipeline
requests.show: Conversation facts -> Ingest -> Embed -> Vector Store; later Query -> Embed -> Similarity Search -> Relevant memories -> Agent context
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that retrieval, not just storage, is the core challenge

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Code introspection to function calling
requests.show: Python function -> introspection -> JSON schema -> LLM tool selection -> structured function call -> registered function execution
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand how frameworks convert native code into model-usable tool interfaces

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Multi-agent delegation and shared context
requests.show: A Supervisor routes work to Researcher and Writer; Researcher writes findings into Shared State, Writer reads them, and the Supervisor maintains control flow
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that delegation and information sharing are separate but complementary responsibilities

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Three framework philosophies
requests.show: Three side-by-side diagrams: CrewAI as roles/tasks flowing through a managed process, ADK as Agent + Tools + Services + Runner components, LangGraph as explicit nodes and edges over shared state
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare abstraction level and control style rather than treating frameworks as interchangeable

requests.lesson_title: Core Components of an Agent Framework
requests.title: Complete agent framework assembly line
requests.show: Instructions, short-term memory, long-term memory, and tool schemas feed into Runtime/Orchestration and the LLM; outputs branch to Tools, Other Agents, or Human Approval, then return to state
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how the five core components cooperate on every execution turn

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: Agent design blueprint
requests.show: A central Math Agent connected to Purpose, Tools, Context, Core Instructions, and Execution Examples
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see that agent design combines capability, knowledge, behavior, and demonstrations before coding begins

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: ADK basic execution architecture
requests.show: User Query -> Session Service + Agent Blueprint -> Runner -> Foundation Model -> Event Stream -> Final Response, with Artifact Service alongside Runner
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should understand that Agent defines behavior while Runner executes it using services

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: Chained tool execution
requests.show: User request -> multiply tool call -> result 6 -> add tool call with [6,4] -> result 10 -> final answer
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the runtime feeds one tool result back into reasoning before the next tool is selected

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: Modular agent project structure
requests.show: Separate boxes for tools.py, context.py, examples.py, and prompt.py all feeding into agent.py, which produces the Agent and session context
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how modularization improves maintainability and allows each concern to evolve independently

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: Manual live architecture vs ADK Live Agent
requests.show: Left: Browser <-> Backend <-> Live API with two manually managed WebSockets; Right: Browser <-> Backend -> ADK Runner -> Agent/Live Model, with Runner abstracting provider streaming
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice which low-level responsibilities move from application code into the framework

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: Agent debugging cockpit
requests.show: A conceptual UI with chat on the right and a trace/state/events panel on the left, highlighting a tool-call event with function name and arguments
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see how observability exposes intermediate execution rather than only the final answer

requests.lesson_title: Designing and Building Agents with ADK
requests.title: End-to-end agent development lifecycle
requests.show: A circular or staged diagram: Design Blueprint -> Basic Agent -> Tools -> Modular Refactor -> Live Agent -> Debug/Trace -> Formal Evaluation -> Improve -> back to Design
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that agent development is iterative, not a one-time coding task

requests.title: Agent Card anatomy

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should compare how connection lifetime changes with task duration

requests.show: Authentication, Transport Security, Authorization/RBAC, Opaque Execution, and Webhook Verification shown as stacked protection layers
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should see security as defense in depth

requests.title: Internal multi-agent plus external A2A architecture

requests.title: A2A Python toolkit roles
