requests.title: Oversampling versus undersampling
requests.show: An imbalanced two-class scatterplot shown before and after undersampling the majority class and oversampling the minority class
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that resampling changes the training distribution, not reality

requests.title: Class-imbalance intervention layers
requests.show: A three-layer diagram showing metric choice, data-level resampling, and algorithm-level loss weighting as different intervention points
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that imbalance can be addressed at evaluation, data, and learning-algorithm levels

requests.title: Three families of data augmentation
requests.show: Three panels showing label-preserving transformation, noisy/perturbed input, and synthesized/mixed examples
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that augmentation can create diversity by transformation, perturbation, or generating new examples

requests.title: Learned versus engineered features
requests.show: A two-part diagram showing raw text/image going directly into a deep model that learns representations, alongside contextual metadata such as user, thread, and behavioral information being explicitly engineered into features
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that representation learning reduces but does not eliminate feature engineering

requests.title: MNAR versus MAR versus MCAR
requests.show: Three small panels showing missing income caused by income itself, missing age explained by another observed group variable, and random missing job values with no visible pattern
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the mechanism causing missingness affects how safely data can be removed or imputed

requests.title: Scaling and standardization comparison
requests.show: A skewed or differently scaled pair of numerical features shown before and after min-max scaling and standardization
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the transformation changes numerical scale while preserving the underlying examples

requests.title: UNKNOWN bucket versus feature hashing
requests.show: A categorical stream with old and new brands, showing one approach mapping all unseen brands to UNKNOWN and another hashing every brand into a fixed index space with occasional collisions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice why hashing handles open-ended vocabularies more gracefully

requests.title: Token embeddings plus positional embeddings
requests.show: A short token sequence with one vector per token and one vector per position, followed by element-wise combination before the model
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that token identity and token order are supplied as separate signals

requests.title: Data leakage shortcut example

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the model learned a shortcut rather than the intended medical signal

requests.title: Leakage-safe preprocessing pipeline
requests.show: A diagram showing deduplication/group handling and time-aware splitting before fitting imputation/scaling on train only, then applying those transformations to validation and test
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that test information must never influence fitted preprocessing steps

requests.title: Global versus local feature importance
requests.show: A simple bar chart of global feature importance next to one individual prediction showing positive and negative feature contributions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that a feature can be important to the model overall and also contribute differently to individual predictions

requests.title: Model selection as a multidimensional trade-off
requests.show: A radar or matrix-style comparison of two model candidates across predictive quality, training cost, inference latency, data requirement, deployability, and interpretability
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the highest-accuracy model is not automatically the best production choice

requests.title: Learning curves for two model families
requests.show: A plot of validation performance versus number of training examples for a simple model and a higher-capacity model, where the simple model starts stronger but the higher-capacity model continues improving
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the best model today may not be the best model after more data arrives

requests.title: Bagging workflow
requests.show: One original dataset branching into several bootstrap samples, each training a model, with model outputs merged by majority vote or averaging
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that learners are trained independently on different resampled datasets

requests.title: Bagging versus boosting versus stacking
requests.show: A three-panel comparison: independent bootstrapped models for bagging, sequential error-focused learners for boosting, and parallel base models feeding a meta-model for stacking
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the different way each ensemble creates and combines diversity

requests.title: Reproducible experiment bundle
requests.show: A central experiment ID connected to code version, data version, hyperparameters, environment, metrics, logs, and model artifacts
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that reproducing an ML experiment requires much more than remembering the learning rate

requests.title: Data, model, and pipeline parallelism
requests.show: Three diagrams: replicated models processing different data shards, one model split across machines, and micro-batches flowing through model stages like an assembly line
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice what is split in each strategy: data, model components, or staged computation

requests.title: Three behavioral model tests
requests.show: Three panels showing realistic perturbation with expected stability, a sensitive attribute swap with an unchanged expected prediction, and a meaningful feature increase with an expected directional output change
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that evaluation can test behavior, not just aggregate accuracy

requests.title: Calibration curve
requests.show: A probability calibration plot with a diagonal perfect-calibration line and one model curve above/below it
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that calibration measures whether probability values themselves are trustworthy, not merely whether ranking is correct

requests.title: Aggregate metric versus slice metrics
requests.show: A large overall accuracy bar beside separate majority/minority bars for two models, showing how the model with the best overall score can perform poorly on one subgroup
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that aggregate metrics can hide critical weaknesses

requests.show: A simple model-plus-API box on the left and a production system on the right containing load balancing, monitoring, alerts, model versions, feature pipelines, and multiple clients
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that exposing an endpoint is only one small part of production deployment

requests.title: Model portfolio at production scale
requests.show: A product with several ML-powered functions connected to many deployed models across regions or countries
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that production ML infrastructure often manages fleets of models, not one isolated model

requests.title: Batch versus online prediction architecture
requests.show: Side-by-side pipelines showing batch feature computation and periodic prediction storage versus request-time model inference through a prediction service
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that batch prediction computes ahead of requests while online prediction computes in response to requests

requests.title: Feature freshness and prediction mode
requests.show: Three horizontal pipelines for batch prediction, online prediction with precomputed batch features, and online prediction combining batch and streaming features
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that 'online feature' does not necessarily mean 'streaming feature'

requests.title: Training-serving skew from duplicate feature pipelines
requests.show: Two paths computing the same feature: an offline batch training pipeline and an online streaming inference pipeline, first matching and then diverging after only one path changes
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how duplicated feature logic creates inconsistent model inputs

requests.title: Four model compression methods
requests.show: Four panels showing low-rank decomposition, teacher-student distillation, weight pruning to sparse connections, and 32-bit to 8-bit quantization
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that all four reduce deployment cost through different mechanisms

requests.title: Cloud versus edge inference
requests.show: A mobile device sending data across a network to a cloud model versus the same device running the model locally, with callouts for cloud cost, network latency, privacy, memory, compute, and battery
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that moving inference to the edge removes some network costs but introduces device constraints

requests.title: Framework to hardware through intermediate representations
requests.show: Several ML frameworks feeding a shared high-level IR, then lower-level IR, then branching to CPU, GPU, and accelerator machine code
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how IRs reduce the need for every framework to directly support every hardware backend

requests.title: Operator fusion reduces memory traffic
requests.show: A before/after diagram where two operators each read and write an intermediate tensor versus one fused operator that keeps the intermediate result local
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that reducing memory movement can speed inference even if the mathematical operations are unchanged

requests.title: Post-deployment ML lifecycle
requests.show: A circular flow from deployment to monitoring, detection, diagnosis, correction/retraining, and redeployment
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that production ML is a continuing feedback process rather than a final release

requests.title: Operational failure versus silent ML failure
requests.show: Two examples: one request timing out with an obvious error, and one request returning a normal-looking but incorrect prediction
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that ML failure can occur while software health looks normal

requests.title: Degenerate recommendation feedback loop
requests.show: Two items begin with nearly equal scores, one is ranked slightly higher, receives more exposure and clicks, then receives a larger future score
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how model outputs can change future training data

requests.title: Position bias correction
requests.show: A ranked recommendation list where top position affects probability of being seen, followed by a two-stage model separating 'seen/considered' from 'clicked given seen'
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that clicks combine item preference with exposure position

requests.title: Covariate shift, label shift, and concept drift
requests.show: Three panels showing changes to P(X), P(Y), and P(Y
requests.learner_should_notice: X), with the unchanged conditional or marginal distribution noted in each case | Learner should notice that 'data drift' is not one single mathematical phenomenon

requests.title: Drift detection from source to target distributions
requests.show: Two overlaid feature distributions with summary-statistic comparison and a two-sample test indicator
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the difference between simple summary monitoring and a formal statistical comparison

requests.title: Sliding versus cumulative monitoring metrics
requests.show: A time series with a sudden performance drop, alongside a responsive sliding metric and a smoother cumulative metric that barely moves
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how cumulative statistics can hide recent incidents

requests.title: Four monitoring layers in an ML pipeline
requests.show: A pipeline from raw inputs to transformed features to predictions to accuracy/feedback metrics, with monitoring attached at each layer
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the trade-off between upstream root-cause visibility and downstream monitoring simplicity

requests.title: Feature monitoring with schema and drift checks
requests.show: A tabular feature set with range checks, category checks, missing-value checks, and distribution comparisons, followed by alerts filtered by model impact
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that feature drift alone does not prove model degradation

requests.title: Distributed tracing across microservices
requests.show: One request ID traveling through several services with timestamps and logs at each hop
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how a shared trace identifier reconstructs the path of one request

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Continual-learning production loop
requests.show: A circular production pipeline showing fresh data and feedback feeding candidate training, evaluation, promotion, deployment, and monitoring
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that continual learning requires an end-to-end update system, not merely a training function

requests.title: Champion-challenger model update
requests.show: A deployed champion copied into one or more challengers, with fresh-data training and an evaluation gate before promotion
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that training and deployment are separated by a quality gate

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the difference in reused model state and data requirements

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Fresh-data paths for continual learning
requests.show: Application events entering a real-time transport, with one path going directly to fresh training/label extraction and another slower path through a warehouse
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how bypassing warehouse delay can make training data fresher

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Label computation from recommendation and click logs
requests.show: A recommendation event and a later click event joined by user/item/context identifiers to create a supervised label
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that user behavior must be matched back to the prediction that generated the opportunity

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Four stages of continual-learning maturity
requests.show: A staircase from manual stateless retraining to automated stateless, automated stateful, and finally trigger-driven continual learning
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the progression is mostly about infrastructure automation, state management, monitoring, and evaluation

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Log-and-wait feature reuse
requests.show: A production inference request whose computed features are logged, then later joined with delayed feedback to create a training example
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that retraining can reuse the exact features seen by the live model

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Trigger-driven continual-learning pipeline
requests.show: Four trigger sources—time, performance, data volume, drift—feeding an update pipeline with training, evaluation gate, model store, and deployment
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that retraining triggers depend on trustworthy monitoring

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production
requests.title: Measuring the value of data freshness
requests.show: Several training windows ending progressively closer to a fixed modern test window, with model performance increasing or flattening as training data becomes fresher

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the passive versus proactive distinction

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the candidate sees real traffic without affecting users

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that bandit allocation adapts as evidence changes

requests.lesson_title: Continual Learning and Test in Production

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that model updates move through standardized quality gates

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the economically attractive option can change with scale

requests.lesson_title: People, UX, and Responsible ML Systems

requests.lesson_title: People, UX, and Responsible ML Systems

requests.lesson_title: People, UX, and Responsible ML Systems

requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that different interfaces operate on the same underlying lifecycle

requests.title: Secure automation versus permission bypass
requests.show: Two paths: service identity with scoped permissions versus a shortcut using overly broad permissions, with the second path leading to security exposure
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that convenience and secure automation are not the same thing

requests.title: Reproducible Azure compute environment
requests.show: Several engineers connecting to a managed Azure compute instance with the same libraries, notebook environment, workspace, and data access
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how a shared environment reduces machine-specific differences

requests.title: Azure model registry version history
requests.show: One model name with versions v1, v2, v3, each with metadata and a production pointer, plus a rollback arrow from v3 to v2
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice why version identity matters during release and rollback

requests.title: Azure deployment target trade-off
requests.show: A simple test deployment path toward ACI and a scalable production deployment path toward AKS/Kubernetes
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that target choice should follow workload and environment requirements

requests.title: From logs to observability
requests.show: A deployed model sending requests, failures, latency, exceptions, and logs into an Application Insights-style dashboard
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that observability combines multiple signals into a system-level story

requests.title: Production issue reproduced locally
requests.show: A production Azure container and an equivalent local Docker container receiving the same failing request, with inspection tools attached locally
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that reproducibility enables safer and deeper debugging

requests.title: Azure pipeline step anatomy
requests.show: A pipeline step showing inputs, Python script/arguments, outputs, compute target, and runtime configuration
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that execution code and execution environment are separate concerns

requests.title: Iterative Azure ML lifecycle
requests.show: A circular lifecycle from training to validation, registration/versioning, deployment, observability, and feedback returning to data/training
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that production feedback changes earlier stages rather than ending the process

requests.title: GCP MLOps technology ecosystem
requests.show: Google Cloud surrounded by Kubernetes, TensorFlow, Go, BigQuery, and Vertex AI, with arrows showing portability beyond one cloud
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the source's emphasis on widely adopted technologies rather than only proprietary services

requests.title: GKE versus Cloud Run abstraction
requests.show: The same ML container shown on a detailed Kubernetes/GKE stack and on a simplified Cloud Run managed-service stack
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that the application can be similar while operational responsibility changes

requests.title: BigQuery-centered MLOps flow
requests.show: Public/streaming/storage data feeding BigQuery, with outputs branching to analytics/BI and machine-learning/Vertex AI workflows
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice why keeping data and some ML operations close together simplifies the pipeline

requests.title: Split CI/CD responsibilities
requests.show: A Git push feeding GitHub Actions for tests/lint, then a deployment path using Cloud Build into GCP
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how two automation systems can serve different strengths in one workflow

requests.title: Kubernetes HPA control loop
requests.show: Metrics feeding an autoscaler that changes the replica/pod count behind a load-balanced ML service
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the closed loop from observation to scaling action

requests.title: Serverless DataOps and AI composition
requests.show: A Cloud Function receiving an event, reading external or cloud data, calling an AI API, and returning/publishing a result
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how serverless functions glue managed services together

requests.title: Light versus heavy GCP MLOps
requests.show: A lightweight path with App Engine/Cloud Build/API call beside a broader Vertex AI path with data/model management, Feature Store, explainability, and quality tracking
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice the trade-off between simplicity and platform capability

requests.title: End-to-end GCP MLOps system
requests.show: A flow from source and CI/CD through storage/BigQuery, modeling/Vertex AI, deployment targets, monitoring, and feedback
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that individual GCP services fit into a broader lifecycle rather than being isolated tools

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Shell script to Python growth path
requests.show: A tiny one-purpose shell script on the left and a larger Python CLI with logging, tests, modules, and dependencies on the right
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that tool choice changes as complexity and maintainability needs grow

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Python virtual environment isolation
requests.show: System Python outside and two isolated project environments containing different dependency versions
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that project dependencies no longer collide with the system or each other

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Three CSV quality failures
requests.show: A table illustrating an all-null column, an unwanted Unnamed index column, and hidden carriage-return characters inside a text field
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how small formatting/data issues can break downstream ML workflows

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Failure-to-automation feedback loop
requests.show: A manual dataset failure becoming a reusable linter rule that protects later ML workflows
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that automation stores lessons learned from past incidents

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Monolith versus reusable microservice pieces
requests.show: An unstable tall Jenga-like monolith beside smaller independent service blocks that can be rearranged and reused
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how reducing coupling improves maintainability and reuse

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Authenticated Cloud Function request path
requests.show: Client sending an authenticated HTTP POST with JSON into a serverless function, with billing/security boundary highlighted
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice that HTTP convenience does not remove the need for authentication

requests.lesson_title: Building MLOps Command Line Tools and Microservices
requests.title: Cloud-backed CLI architecture
requests.show: A terminal command calling a packaged Click CLI, which authenticates and sends HTTP JSON to a cloud function that invokes a managed ML API
requests.learner_should_notice: Learner should notice how packaging hides repetitive cloud plumbing behind one stable command
